title: Chapter 1007
paragraphs: Chapter 1007
Episode 246. Battle for the Mithra Desert (17)
Tower of Tales.
"The Red Plutonian has proposed a temporary alliance."
Kelliac said after checking the letter sent by Limagas.
"Are they out of their minds, after stealing Drakka like that?"
Contrary to the incredulous response, Ragal thought that the Red Plutonian had made a very good proposal.
He had personally witnessed Elona return injured. When deploying Elona this time, Ziffle had never considered the possibility of her getting hurt.
Even if the Red Plutonian suddenly went insane and attacked Elona. It was clear that she could always escape danger.
But to get such a severe injury from an attack that came across dimensions from inside Laprarosa, and then for those lunatics from the Red Plutonian to send a letter immediately.
It was a point that made them re-realize the danger of the Plutonian.
The leaders looked to Kelliac for guidance. He looked quite upset seeing Elona return.
'... Elona tried not to use the power of the Holy Crown until the very end. Moreover, she's intentionally returning to the tower, not the sanctuary, to recover.'
This was a clear sign that Elona was trying to escape the control of the Holy Crown.
Right now, Elona would recover fastest in the sanctuary, and every time the holy land healed her, it could adjust the control of the Holy Crown more powerfully.
Elona couldn't have been unaware of these facts. Kelliac noticed that the control of the Holy Crown was weakening faster than expected.
Especially now, when moving and repairing the sanctuary due to Laprarosa was being delayed. Kelliac sighed, rubbing his forehead.
"Did I put too much hope in an artifact from the old era...?"
"Friend Kelliac?"
"We'll accept the Red Plutonian’s proposal. As soon as Elona recovers, deploy her with Kadun, the White Night, Phantom Army, and Demon Army."
[You think those Red Plutonian bastards won't stab us in the back, Kelliac?]

"If they had such intentions, they would've attacked the moment Elona got hurt. Besides, both they and we are in a position to tear each other apart when the opportunity arises. The situation is continuously changing rapidly."
The Battle for the Mitra Desert flowed unpredictably fast. Neither Kelliac nor any of the pillars of the major powers could decipher its course.
"Then maybe, it might be better to intensify the chaos."
[What do you mean?]
"We need to meet with Ganesto again. And also discuss with the Sun God religion. We have to prevent them from continuously watching from across the river."
May 14, 1804, above the Tikan Palace, on the Golden Ship.
Jin and the Alliance members were gathered in a lab inside the Golden Ship, examining the liberation device created by Qwaul.
"It looks just ordinary. Was it so difficult to make this, Qwaul?"
Murakan commented.

True to his words, the device looked like a simple cylindrical container made of metal. Roughly the size of his upper body and weighing 50 kilograms. However, when a protruding button in the center was pressed firmly, the device unfolded like wings, revealing dozens of metal rods from within.

These rods were components that tracked 'waves'. Naturally, they were set to Laprarosa. Thanks to having already created a resonance device for battle god fusion in the past, they could easily tune it.
"Why don't you try making one yourself?"
"I was just saying. Good job! With this, we can extract the Plutonian members from Laprarosa, right?"

“If it can operate safely for twelve hours. The device itself is perfect. Performance verification is complete, and the production process is optimized. It’s the fruit of all our researchers' efforts…”
Uncharacteristically, Qwaul emphasized that the development of this device was a collective achievement, his eyes becoming red-rimmed.
And it indeed was.
From Sayel Rootbeer, magic engineers recruited from all over after the Evil God War, to Teben Hister and Zen Rootbeer met from Maliet's legacy, Lelo, and even Valeria and Eltiot.
Qwaul was confident that without even one of them, they couldn't have developed the liberation device this quickly. Everyone had dedicated sleepless nights to research and development.
Always living as an eccentric and antisocial genius engineer, he was now becoming accustomed to collaboration and solidarity.
Murakan handed Qwa
ul a handkerchief with a disgusted expression.
"Now, everything depends on the leader and you guys."
Next to the device, there was an ancient millennial iron protection box brought from the Blacksmith's Island by Bailam. It had handles for throwing on all four sides.
Thanks to the alliance with the mines held by Runkandel and the Blacksmith's Island, they could use this ancient millennial iron as a consumable.
The comrades carefully placed the liberation device into the box. They then lifted and shook it, checking the fastening state and whether the handles were comfortable to grip.
"It's much lighter than my sword. Still, given that it's made of ancient millennial iron, it's quite sturdy. Even if thrown with all one's might, it won't shatter."
"It looks that way to me, too, White Whale."
"If Sister Luna and Master Hedo say it's good, then the box must be exceptional. After all, this was also personally crafted by Lord Picon. Now... we can begin."
Jin looked around at his colleagues with a determined gaze.
A total of 13 members had been chosen to carry out the first liberation device throwing operation.
Team 1 consisted of Jin, Luna, Dante, Bellize, and Linpa.
Team 2 was made up of Talaris, Eltiot, Vanessa, and Hedo.
Team 3 had Valeria, Cyris, Yona, and Owl.

"As discussed in the meeting earlier, Team 1 will be in charge of breaking through. Team 2 will cause distractions, and Team 3 will gather information and, when appropriate, deliver the liberation device to Team 1 or 2, or throw it themselves."
Each team's role was equally crucial. If Team 1 couldn't break through, there would be no opportunity to throw the device. Team 2 had to make sure Team 1 didn't bear the brunt of all enemy fire.
As Teams 1 and 2 couldn't engage in battle while holding the liberation device, Team 3 especially needed to move flexibly.
"Though it might be challenging to succeed on our first attempt, I have a good feeling about this. Let's go!"
The operation members climbed aboard the Red Owl and Mot one by one.
In no time, the Red Owl and Mot took them to the border of the desert. Each team started from a different point.

Upon arrival in the desert, Valeria from Team 3 immediately took her position and deployed a recording spell. She wanted to check if the information gathered by the alliance's informants matched with the actual events in the desert, and if there were any new updates.
Meanwhile, Owl, Yona, and Siris checked the infiltration routes.
"Uh, Yona. The shock from their attacks on the dimensional gate is reaching even here. It’s better I stay hidden while you move around the battlefield to protect the device with my spirit energy."
"Hehe, alright, Owl nim. The power of the youngest, the spirit energy, is really amazing. Wrapping it around the device definitely reduces its presence.
"The fact that the Spirit Energy form remains even from this distance is the most remarkable part. We should move while maintaining the distance where the Spirit Energy is sustained."
Upon arriving at the desert's edge, Team 2, led by Talaris, immediately began their advance into the battlefield.
"Huh, I never thought I’d use the secret techniques of Ice Castle/Secret Palace just for the sake of distraction. Hopefully, the Red Plutonian and Ziffle will be easily deceived."
As they entered the desert, Red Energy Waves spread out thickly, like a venomous fog.
Talaris planned to use the secret techniques of Myriad Ice like during the Sword Emperor's War. With the Great Ice Plain and White, two types of swords. She aided in liberating Laprarosa.
The enemy couldn't possibly know the special nature of the Myriad Ice or the randomness of the Laprarosa path. Therefore, it was premature for them to assume there was no connection between the two.
Perhaps Talris's sword really could have an influence.

"As expected, just as the Lord predicted, it seems the Ziffle and the Red Plutonian have formed a temporary alliance, Ice Castle Lord. Even with just a visual check, they are not attacking each other at all."

"Tch, that Red Plutonian, no matter how baseless, to join hands with those who took their capital just a short while ago? That Kelliac guy is no different either. In my time, such a thing was unimaginable. They have no pride. Thankfully, it looks like our descendants are doing well."
Team 1 was infiltrating the battlefield slightly faster than Team 2.
Already, some of the cannons from the fleet attacking the dimension gate were targeting Team 1. But unless it was the main gun of the aerial fortress, they posed no threat to these five.
Simat, seeing Team 1 approach, didn't rashly turn the main cannon of the aerial fortress. He knew very well that this was exactly what Jin and his group wanted.
"These guys are tricky, Brother Jin. It seems like we'll have to start directly attacking the aerial fortress to make them turn their cannons?"
"That's what I'm thinking too, Jin."
"Fortunately... still, that... Elona Jipl... doesn't seem to be... there."
"First, Luna and I will target Rital, while you and the Two Kings can attack Pibil. How about that?"
Upon Jin's nod, Luna and Dante charged towards Rital, unleashing waves of sword energy.
"Ha, friends who aren't even Mingwang clan members are fighting just like us. I really like Jin brother's relatives. The rest of our brothers will surely like them too once they come out."
"Right..."
Jin and the two kings accelerated their pace.
Pibil and the aerial fortresses were still evading Masalrun's curse, circling in the sky. But the intervals at which the main cannons fired at the dimension gate had decreased considerably.
While they were narrowing the distance with Pivil, Jin and the brothers suddenly stopped.
The three felt a familiar Energy Waves being emitted from the passage of Laprarosa.
"Jin brother! This... it's Teto's energy!?"
Twelve Battle Kings Teto. Just like when Belize and Linpa had emerged, his energy was escaping from the passage.
And that wasn't all. Shortly after, the three of them felt another Energy Waves pounding the desert.
"...This time it's Garmund brother!"
It was the energy of Eight Battle King’s Garmund.
